exposure: gestational age at delivery (preterm vs. term)
severity of adverse events (postpartum, intrapartum non-near-miss, and intrapartum near-miss)
cohort: Women with viable fetuses who experienced obstetric adverse events at hospitals and health centers in Tanzania and Uganda between December 2015 and September 2017
finding: Stillbirth risk increased with the severity of intrapartum complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower risk of stillbirth compared to vaginal delivery after intrapartum non-near-miss adverse events.
